# Goldens expected to be unsupported on wasm, for both wasm tests (one list
# since 2026-11-05; gotchas/wasm-two-unsupported-lists.md).
#
# TestSelfhostWasm (wasip1/wasm, 2026-10-29) does not try a listed golden,
# and fails on a golden that is not listed and becomes unsupported, so a
# regression such as 0.34.0's (Chan programs refused for wasm for twelve
# days) cannot hide in the unsupported count. It reads the name, up to the
# first `#`; the reason after it is for reading only.
#
# TestWasmCommandGoldens (wasip2/wasm components, decision 0447 stage 3,
# 2026-11-02) tries every golden. It expects to fail exactly the lines with
# a second part, `# wasip2: REASON`: a golden failing there unlisted, or
# listed there and passing, fails the test. A golden listed with no wasip2
# part (most need the network or processes that preview 1 lacks) must pass
# as a component.

cmd_inherit # the wasm backend does not support processes (`proc.exec`): WASI preview1 has none # wasip2: XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.exec)
conn_deadline # the wasm backend does not support the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
conn_iface # the wasm backend does not support the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
dns_no_tasks # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.call_c2` (std/dns's native resolver)
dns_records # the wasm backend does not support the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
fs_atomic # operation not supported (WASI has no file modes or locks): write_atomic's mode # wasip2: WASI has no file modes or locks: write_atomic's mode
